company.shortDescription: Escrow payment solution for individuals and small businesses
company.description: Waffy is an online platform that enables users to buy and sell safely via a trusted escrow service. It is the first of its kind in Saudi Arabia and the MENA region.

productsAndServices.description: An escrow payment platform that holds buyer funds securely until product or service delivery is confirmed, protecting both buyers and sellers in transactions.
productsAndServices.name: WaffyApp Escrow Payment Service

productsAndServices.description: A specialized escrow service for brokers to securely manage client funds and transactions, ensuring protection and transparency for all parties involved.
productsAndServices.name: WaffyApp Broker Escrow Service

productsAndServices.description: A service enabling secure sale and delivery of digital products by withholding access codes or tickets until payment confirmation.
productsAndServices.name: WaffyApp Digital Product Sales Support

productsAndServices.description: A service that manages transaction disputes by temporarily holding funds and facilitating communication and resolution between buyers and sellers.
productsAndServices.name: WaffyApp Dispute Resolution and Transaction Management

productsAndServices.description: Integration of multiple secure payment options including credit cards, Apple Pay, bank transfers, and installment plans to facilitate transactions.
productsAndServices.name: WaffyApp Payment Methods Integration

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 95.24% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,168,130 to $13,564,989, a 6.26x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 27 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
